$comment: Over-trigger probe for the stated title (owner decisions, 2026-10-06; docs/model-contracts.md §4.3, §6). Six one-line prompts, run alone and only when the owner approves the paid run: node scripts/corpus/run-live.mjs preview --file docs/model-evals/stated-title-probe.json --out <dir>. Not part of the corpus. Each case's `expectTitle` is the title fact extraction should return after the guard (null: none), and the card's title must be exactly that when it is not null.

cases.prompt: A baby shower that feels “boho” and relaxed, lots of dried grasses and warm neutrals
A “Bluey” party for our daughter turning four, bright and silly
cases.why: the bare name of a show the party is themed on: the design writes a title evoking it, without the name

cases.prompt: Baby shower with a big balloon banner that says “Oh Baby” over a dessert table
cases.why: words meant for something in the scene

cases.prompt: A taco-themed baby shower called Taco ’Bout a Baby, colourful and fun
Sixtieth birthday dinner for my dad, who loves sailing and good red wine
cases.why: a plain prompt that names nothing

cases.prompt: Our wedding shower should feel like “here comes the sun” — golden morning light, citrus and linen
cases.why: a song lyric in quotation marks
